calls.summary:
# GrowthBook Live Demo - Sep 24
Date: 2026-09-24 | Duration: 42m

## Summary
Growth Book combines feature flagging, experimentation, and product analytics to help teams make better product decisions and iterate faster. Feature flags support gradual rollouts, precise targeting, ramp-up schedules, automatic rollback, multiple environments, audit logs, and role-based governance. Embedded experiments split traffic across variants, track goals and guardrails, and support Bayesian and frequentist analysis, health checks, sub-cohort breakdowns, multi-armed and contextual bandits, holdouts, and power analysis. Only about a third of shipped features positively affect business metrics, making win-rate tracking and rigorous testing valuable. AI can use historical experiments to generate hypotheses, design tests, interpret results, and produce reports. Product analytics provides warehouse-native, natural-language querying, dashboards, funnels, journey visualizations, and visible SQL. SDKs support event logging and exposure tracking, while personalization remains limited and under consideration.

## Keywords
feature flagging, experimentation platform, AI assistant, product analytics, Bayesian analysis, multi-armed bandits
